lines.3: 「Ahaha, I tried writing an email, but I couldn't fit everything in, so I ended up calling.」
lines.5: She really was more swept up in this than I was.
lines.6: I liked Konoe, but I was more levelheaded than I'd expected.
lines.7: Maybe I really was the more mature one.
lines.8: I'd cherish Konoe without turning us into a lovey-dovey idiot couple.
lines.9: That was easier said than done.
lines.10: What an absurdly luxurious problem to have.
